description: Approves temporary daycare for 30 children, 4-5 staff at 1615 1st.
Approval is for 24 months, requiring reapplication.

chips.text: Councillor Donauer warned proponent against expecting automatic re-approval in two years.
260 children are on the daycare's waitlist for spaces.
Administration recommended denial for 34 children; Council approved 30 children.
This is the first of several large daycare applications expected.
Five public responses supported the daycare, four expressed concerns.
City Solicitor stated discretionary use approval cannot be rescinded due to complaints.
Daycare relies on government funding and $10/day parent fees.
Applicant offered to clear snow for two to three parking spaces.

description: Permits place of worship and independent school.
Limits school to 40 students, daycare to 32.
Requires second site access to rear lane.

chips.text: Ukrainian Catholic Cathedral St. George supported the proposed amendments.
Proposed school aims to serve students from low-income households.
